lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je sau lochai ra(n)g na hovai koi ||3||
lines.translation: Even if he wishes it a hundred times, he does not obtain the Lord's Love. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur paavai ||
lines.translation: But if the Lord blesses him with His Glance of Grace, then he meets the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har ras har ra(n)g samaavai ||4||2||6||
lines.translation: Nanak is absorbed into the subtle essence of the Lord's Love. ||4||2||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਹੀ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihavaa har ras rahee aghaai ||
lines.translation: My tongue remains satisfied with the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh peevai sahaj samaai ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh drinks it in, and merges in celestial peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਨ ਚਾਖਹੁ ਜੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras jan chaakhahu je bhaaee ||
lines.translation: If you taste the subtle essence of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਤ ਅਨਤ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau kat anat saad lobhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: then how can you be enticed by other flavors? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat ras raakhahu ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instructions, keep this subtle essence enshrined in your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har ras raate ra(n)g muraar ||2||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the subtle essence of the Lord, are immersed in celestial bliss. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh har ras chaakhiaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh cannot even taste the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: haumai karai bahutee milai sajaai ||3||
lines.translation: He acts out in ego, and suffers terrible punishment. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare taa har ras paavai ||
lines.translation: But if he is blessed with the Lord's Kind Mercy, then he obtains the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har ras har gun gaavai ||4||3||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, absorbed in this subtle essence of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||3||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ghar 6 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Sixth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: neech jaat har japatiaa utam padavee paai ||
lines.translation: When someone of low social class chants the Lord's Name, he obtains the state of highest dignity.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੈ ਕਿਸਨੁ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: poochhahu bidar daasee sutai kisan utariaa ghar jis jaai ||1||
lines.translation: Go and ask Bidar, the son of a maid; Krishna himself stayed in his house. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee akath kathaa sunahu jan bhaaee jit sahasaa dookh bhookh sabh lahi jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Listen, O humble Siblings of Destiny, to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord; it removes all anxiety, pain and hunger. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਾਰੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਇਕ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ravidaas chamaar usatat kare har keerat nimakh ik gaai ||
lines.translation: Ravi Daas, the leather-worker, praised the Lord, and sang the Kirtan of His Praises each and every instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਜਾਤਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਪਏ ਪਗਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: patit jaat utam bhaiaa chaar varan pae pag aai ||2||
lines.translation: Although he was of low social status, he was exalted and elevated, and people of all four castes came and bowed at his feet. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਦੇਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲੋਕੁ ਛੀਪਾ ਕਹੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamade preet lagee har setee lok chheepaa kahai bulaai ||
lines.translation: Naam Dayv loved the Lord; the people called him a fabric dyer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਪਿਠਿ ਦੇ ਛੋਡੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਲੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khatree braahaman pith de chhode har naamadeu leeaa mukh laai ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord turned His back on the high-class Kh'shaatriyas and Brahmins, and showed His face to Naam Dayv. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਿਨ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਢਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jitane bhagat har sevakaa mukh athasath teerath tin tilak kadhaai ||
lines.translation: All of the devotees and servants of the Lord have the tilak, the ceremonial mark, applied to their foreheads at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪਰਸੇ ਜੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tin kau anadin parase je kripaa kare har raai ||4||1||8||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak shall touch their feet night and day, if the Lord, the King, grants His Grace. ||4||1||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinhee a(n)tar har aaraadhiaa jin kau dhur likhiaa likhat lilaaraa ||
lines.translation: They alone worship and adore the Lord deep within, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny from the very beginning of time.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee bakheelee koee kiaa kare jin kaa a(n)g kare meraa har karataaraa ||1||
lines.translation: What can anyone do to undermine them? My Creator Lord is on their side. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har dhiaai man mere man dhiaai har janam janam ke sabh dookh nivaaranahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: So meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. Meditate on the Lord, O mind; He is the Eliminator of all the pains of reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur bhagat janaa kau bakhasiaa har a(n)mrit bhagat bha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: In the very beginning, the Lord blessed His devotees with the Ambrosial Nectar, the treasure of devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh hovai s un kee rees kare tis halat palat muhu kaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: Anyone who tries to compete with them is a fool; his face shall be blackened here and hereafter. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: se bhagat se sevakaa jinaa har naam piaaraa ||
lines.translation: They alone are devotees, and they alone are selfless servants, who love the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਪਵੈ ਛਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee sevaa te har paaeeai sir ni(n)dak kai pavai chhaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: By their selfless service, they find the Lord, while ashes fall on the heads of the slanderers. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis ghar viratee soee jaanai jagat gur naanak poochh karahu beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: He alone knows this, who experiences it within the home of his own self. Ask Guru Nanak, the Guru of the world, and reflect upon it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਪੀੜੀ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: chahu peeRee aad jugaad bakheelee kinai na paaio har sevak bhaai nisataaraa ||4||2||9||
lines.translation: Throughout the four generations of the Gurus, from the beginning of time and throughout the ages, no one has ever found the Lord by back-biting and undermining. Only by serving the Lord with love, is one emancipated. ||4||2||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai har aaraadheeai tithai har mit sahaaee ||
lines.translation: Wherever the Lord is worshipped in adoration, there the Lord becomes one's friend and helper.
